lead: Premchand was a novelist, born on 31 July 1880 in Varanasi.
He died on 8 October 1936 in Varanasi at the age of 56.
He is associated with work such as Godaan, Bazaar-e-Husn and Karmabhoomi.

sections.heading: Premchand — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Premchand was born on 31 July 1880 in Varanasi, and holds citizenship of British Raj.
His listed education includes University of Allahabad.
He is recorded as speaking Hindustani, Hindi and Urdu.

sections.heading: Premchand — Career and Professional Work
paras: Premchand works primarily as a novelist, screenwriter, essayist, editor and short story writer.
Among the credits most often linked to Premchand are Godaan, Bazaar-e-Husn, Karmabhoomi, Shatranj ke khiladi, Gaban and Nirmala.
